examples.english: We wrote the homework before eating
I said to him we wrote the homework.
Before the match we wrote the homework.
examples.transliteration: Qabla al mubara nahnu katabna al wajib.

examples.arabic: نحن كتبنا الواجب ثم ذهبنا الى المطبخ
examples.english: We wrote the homework then we went to the kitchen.
examples.transliteration: Nahnu katabna al-wajib thumma dhahabna ila al-matbakh

examples.arabic: نحن كتبنا الواجب في ثلاثة كتب
examples.english: We wrote the homework in three books.
examples.transliteration: Nahnu katabna al-wajib fi thalathat kutub

examples.arabic: ثم يقول هل كتبنا الواجب اليوم
examples.english: Then he says "Did we write the homework today?"
examples.transliteration: Thumma yaqul hal katabna al-wajib al-yawm
